newsitem.title: USA: Owens-Illinois to redeem $450 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Owens-Illinois to redeem $450 mln of notes.

text.p: Owens-Illinois Inc said Friday it will call for redemption of $450 million principal amount of its senior subordinated notes.
The company said the notes being called include all $250 million of its 10 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002 and all $200 million of its 9.75 percent senior subordinated notes due 2004.

The 2002 notes will be redeemed Aug. 1 at a redemption price of 105 percent of principal plus accrued interest, the company said. The 2004 notes will be redeemed Aug. 15 at a redemption price of 104.875 percent of principal plus accrued interest.
The redemption will be funded through the company's bank credit facility, it said.

When the two redemptions are completed, the company will have refinanced more than $1.8 billion in outstanding public debt since the start of the year. The refinancings are part of a plan to reduce interest expenses, trim long-term debt, cut the debt-to-equity ratio and improve financial flexiblity, it said.
The company said it also contemplates redeeming all $100 million of its 9.95 percent senior subordinated notes due 2004 when they become redeemable on Oct. 15.
